"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support expanding pension portability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support protecting employee pension funds.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support President Clinton's veto of the Republican tax scheme that would have diminished anti-discrimination protections for middle-class and lower-income workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore has proposed the creation of Retirement Savings Plus, which are voluntary, tax-free, personally-controlled, privately-managed savings accounts with a government match.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Retirement Savings Plus accounts would let Americans save and invest on top of the foundation of Social Security's guaranteed benefit.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Under the Retirement Savings Plus plan, the federal government would match individual contributions with tax credits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Under the Retirement Savings Plus plan, the hardest-pressed working families would get the most assistance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Retirement Savings Plus accounts would allow couples to build a nest egg of up to $400,000.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
